name: Dragon Fruit (Pitaya)
siboNotes: Dragon fruit is well-tolerated for SIBO patients as it's naturally low in FODMAPs and has mild, gentle fiber content.
preparationTips: Cut in half lengthwise and scoop out flesh with a spoon
Peel skin and cube the flesh for fruit salads
Chill before serving for best texture and flavor
Choose fruits that yield slightly to pressure but aren't mushy
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
Good source of iron and magnesium
Contains beneficial plant compounds called betalains
Low in calories with high water content
